output_format.description: Output format: cli (human-readable), csv, xml, or json. NOTE: This option must go before any other options currently.

scan_dir.description: Directory to recursively scan for executable security features.

scan_file.description: Single file path to scan for security features.

proc_pid.description: Process ID to inspect for security features.

proc_all.description: If true, scan all running processes.

proc_libs.description: Process ID to inspect all libraries of.

kernel_config.description: Path to kernel config file (empty = use running kernel).

fortify_file.description: Path to file to check for fortifiability.

fortify_proc.description: Process ID to check for fortifiability.

update.description: Check source for a signed update and update the application if available.
